label: Episode 21
logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.
notes: no clip met the brief; best effort returned

CLIP: episode 21, 1 segment(s), 37s
[00:03.50-00:04.80] SOUND: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
[00:03.60-00:08.50] CAMERA: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.
[00:04.20-00:08.00] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked): "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
[00:08.20-00:10.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
[00:08.50-00:11.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.
[00:08.50-00:11.00] LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent): "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
[00:11.20-00:15.10] CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.
[00:11.20-00:15.00] PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless): "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
[00:15.00-00:18.20] LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained): "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
[00:15.10-00:18.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.
[00:18.20-00:21.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
[00:18.20-00:21.70] PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful): "He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"
[00:21.80-00:25.00] CAMERA: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.
[00:21.80-00:25.30] PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful): "The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"
[00:25.00-00:30.90] CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
[00:25.10-00:27.40] LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected): "We have no clinic now."
[00:27.50-00:30.80] LADY JULIANA (Despondent): "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."
[00:31.00-00:33.00] ACTION: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
[00:31.00-00:35.80] PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate): "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"
[00:31.10-00:35.80] CAMERA: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.
[00:35.80-00:39.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
[00:35.90-00:40.50] CAMERA: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.
[00:35.90-00:40.40] LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative): "Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."
[00:40.50-00:40.65] CAMERA: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
[00:40.50-00:40.65] ACTION: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
